description: Loads one public web page in a real browser and reports which analytics and ad conversion tags were seen, which were not, and which could not be verified. Use when someone asks whether a business website's tracking is set up. Takes up to about a minute. Results are cached for 24 hours per domain. A server-side or consent-gated setup can be invisible to this check and still work.

url.description: The website to check, such as example.com

name: check_site_tracking
title: Check a website's ad and conversion tracking
